import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
python = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")
result = subprocess.run(
    [
        python,
        str(repo / "jobpipe.py"),
        "autopilot",
        "--profile",
        "config/jobpipe.search.yaml",
        "--scout-limit",
        "1",
        "--resolve-limit",
        "2",
        "--apply-limit",
        "1",
        "--headless",
        "--continue-on-user",
    ],
    cwd=repo,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    timeout=900,
)
print(result.stdout)
print(result.stderr)
print(f"exit={result.returncode}")
raise SystemExit(0 if result.returncode in (0, 10) else result.returncode)
